responsibility: Implements the mini-DSL accepted by -fdiagnostics-add-output= and -fdiagnostics-set-output= and the corresponding sink-construction logic. This file parses scheme names and KEY=VALUE parameter lists, reports syntax and semantic errors through an output_spec::context, validates per-scheme options for text, SARIF, and experimental HTML outputs, and constructs the appropriate diagnostics::sink instances and output files from the parsed specification.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the output-spec pair: it contains the parser, scheme handlers, validation, sink-construction logic, and selftests for the -fdiagnostics output DSL, whereas output-spec.h only defines the abstract parsing/reporting context API.
